title: Muscle Building with Functional Endurance (HYROX)
author: Playhaa
desc: Transform your fitness journey with the hypertrophy (building muscle size) with functional endurance program, a comprehensive 17-week training plan designed for those looking to build strength, endurance, and aesthetics. Committing just three days a week, you'll engage in a balanced mix of high-intensity workouts and targeted resistance training, optimizing your performance for HYROX competitions while sculpting your physique. This program is perfect for everyday lifters seeking to elevate their fitness game and achieve impressive results. Get ready to push your limits and redefine your potential!
